main:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Reads a matrix dimension n, fills an n x n matrix with sequential integers, then processes n*n position inputs to mark cells as zero and accumulate the minimum adjusted distance to the matrix edges for interior cells, finally printing the accumulated count." main]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> n </REF>: int "Matrix dimension read from standard input"
        <REF> p </REF>: long "Position value read from standard input in the main loop"
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> cnt </REF>: long "Accumulated sum of minimum adjusted distances for interior cells, printed to standard output"
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Declare integer variable n, 2D integer array a of size 501x501, and long variables p, k initialized to 1, and cnt initialized to 0. RESULT n, a, p, k, cnt]
            [COMMAND Read an integer value from standard input into variable n using scanf. RESULT n]
            [COMMAND For each row i from 0 to n-1, for each column j from 0 to n-1, assign the current value of k to a[i][j] and then increment k by 1. RESULT a]
            [COMMAND For each iteration ii from 0 to n*n-1, read a long value from standard input into variable p using scanf. RESULT p]
            [COMMAND Within the loop over ii, if p is between 1 and n inclusive, set the element a[0][p-1] to 0. RESULT a]
            [COMMAND Within the loop over ii, if p is between n*n-n+1 and n*n inclusive, set the element a[n-1][n-(n*n)+p-1] to 0. RESULT a]
            [COMMAND Within the loop over ii, if p modulo n equals 0, set the element a[(p/n)-1][n-1] to 0. RESULT a]
            [COMMAND Within the loop over ii, if p modulo n equals 1, set the element a[p/n][0] to 0. RESULT a]
            [COMMAND Within the loop over ii, for any other value of p, set the element a[p/n][(p%n)-1] to 0, then declare long variables i equal to p/n and j equal to (p%n)-1, and initialize a long array m of size 5 with values {i, n-1-i, j, n-1-j}. RESULT a, i, j, m]
            [COMMAND Within the else branch, for each jj from 0 to i-1, if a[jj][j] equals 0, decrement m[0] by 1. RESULT m]
            [COMMAND Within the else branch, for each jj from n-1 down to i+1, if a[jj][j] equals 0, decrement m[1] by 1. RESULT m]
            [COMMAND Within the else branch, for each jj from 0 to j-1, if a[i][jj] equals 0, decrement m[2] by 1. RESULT m]
            [COMMAND Within the else branch, for each jj from n-1 down to j+1, if a[i][jj] equals 0, decrement m[3] by 1. RESULT m]
            [COMMAND Within the else branch, sort the first 4 elements of array m in ascending order using qsort with the compare_int comparator. RESULT m]
            [COMMAND Within the else branch, assign the minimum value m[0] to a new long variable mm, and add mm to cnt. RESULT mm, cnt]
            [COMMAND After the loop over ii completes, print the value of cnt as a long integer followed by a newline using printf. RESULT output]
            [COMMAND Return 0 from the main function. RESULT return]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
